item.title: The Ministry of Education and Higher Education has launched a new institutional initiative, the "Solutions Challenge", bringing together ex…
item.description:
The Ministry of Education and Higher Education has launched a new institutional initiative, the "Solutions Challenge", bringing together expertise from its departments and the school community to devise practical solutions that simplify procedures and improve the efficiency of services for students, parents and schools. The initiative was announced at an educational meeting organised by the Schools and Students Affairs Department, attended by officials and public school principals, and Assistant Undersecretary for Educational Affairs Ibrahim Abdullah Al Mohannadi stressed the importance of harnessing national talent within the ministry and schools.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/21/11/2026/education-ministry-launches-solutions-challenge-to-improve-educational-services · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265531/nation/moehe-launches-initiative-to-develop-educational-services

item.title: In its weekly report, QNB attributed the widening productivity gap between the United States and Europe mainly to differences in technologi…
item.description:
In its weekly report, QNB attributed the widening productivity gap between the United States and Europe mainly to differences in technological development rather than a temporary shock, and said the wave of artificial intelligence investment is likely to widen the gap in the near term. The report cited OECD forecasts of US growth of 2.2% in 2026 and 2.1% in 2027, against 1.0% for the euro area in both years, and identified three paths to narrowing the gap: a larger technology sector, a shift in investment towards ICT and intangible capital, and faster technology adoption by firms of all sizes.

item.title: The organising committee of the State of Qatar pavilion at Expo 2027 Yokohama in Japan has unveiled the pavilion's official logo, designed …
item.description:
The organising committee of the State of Qatar pavilion at Expo 2027 Yokohama in Japan has unveiled the pavilion's official logo, designed by Qatari artist Zainab Al Shaibani. The logo draws on the Qatari agal, which resembles the number eight when untied, linking it to the curves of the letters Qaf and Ta in the word Qatar, with touches of Japanese calligraphic aesthetics and vertical orientation to express the cultural ties between the two countries.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/21/11/2026/qatar-pavilion-organizing-committee-unveils-official-logo-for-expo-2027-yokohama · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/20/qatar-pavilion-organizing-committee-unveils-official-logo-for-expo-2027-yokohama

item.title: The Ministry of Public Health and the Primary Health Care Corporation said including the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine in the National…
item.description:
The Ministry of Public Health and the Primary Health Care Corporation said including the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine in the National School Vaccination Campaign for the 2026-2027 academic year aims at early prevention of HPV-related diseases and cancers, chiefly cervical cancer, and that it is offered to both male and female students. The first phase ran from 20 September to 18 November for Grade 9 students, and the second runs from 25 April to 16 May 2027, while the wider campaign covers 301 schools and more than 75,000 students.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/21/11/2026/phcc-strengthens-cancer-prevention-through-hpv-vaccination-programme · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/253564/latest-news/moph-announces-inclusion-of-hpv-vaccine-in-national-school-vaccination-campaign

item.title: Al Sadd went provisionally top of the Doha Bank Stars League after beating Lusail 3-2 at Jassim Bin Hamad Stadium in round ten, drawing lev…
item.description:
Al Sadd went provisionally top of the Doha Bank Stars League after beating Lusail 3-2 at Jassim Bin Hamad Stadium in round ten, drawing level with Al Rayyan and Al Duhail on 21 points and leading on goal difference after Al Duhail lost 1-2 to Qatar SC. Elsewhere, Al Gharafa came from two goals down to beat Al Arabi 3-2. The round concludes today, Saturday, with Al Wakrah against Al Sailiya at 4pm, then Al Rayyan against Al Shahania at 6.30pm at Suhaim Bin Hamad Stadium, where a win would return Al Rayyan to the top.

item.title: The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said a tanker transiting outbound from the Strait of Hormuz was hit on the stern by an unkn…
item.description:
The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said a tanker transiting outbound from the Strait of Hormuz was hit on the stern by an unknown projectile north of Khasab in Oman, with no casualties and no confirmed environmental impact, and advised vessels to transit with caution. Gulf News, citing Reuters, said the tanker caught fire and that Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed it had struck a naval mine near Khasab, while Al Jazeera reported two tankers hit in incidents north and east of Khasab and an IRGC claim that it downed a US MQ-9 drone over the strait.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-trump-says-iran-wants-deal-but-terms-are-unacceptable-1.500755788 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-5-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-today-nov-21-2026-1.500755918 · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/21/iran-war-live-saudi-led-coalition-repels-houthi-missiles

item.title: The Saudi-led coalition and the Houthis exchanged threats to bomb key ports: after the coalition urged civilians to evacuate areas of Hodei…
item.description:
The Saudi-led coalition and the Houthis exchanged threats to bomb key ports: after the coalition urged civilians to evacuate areas of Hodeidah port, Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree threatened Jeddah port and all Saudi Red Sea ports, and warned airlines away from Saudi airspace. The warning does not constitute an official airspace closure, while Reuters reported that Yemeni government forces are strengthening defences around Aden as the Houthis advance along the western coast.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/saudi-coalition-and-houthis-exchange-threats-to-bomb-key-ports · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-5-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-today-nov-21-2026-1.500755918

item.title: Etihad Airways has extended the cancellation of all passenger and cargo flights between Abu Dhabi and both Riyadh and Dammam until 30 Novem…
item.description:
Etihad Airways has extended the cancellation of all passenger and cargo flights between Abu Dhabi and both Riyadh and Dammam until 30 November due to regional disruption, while its other flights to the Kingdom operate as scheduled. Emirates, flydubai and Air Arabia continue to run varying schedules to Saudi cities, and carriers are urging passengers to check their flight status before heading to the airport.

item.title: Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, discussed regional developments in a phone call…
item.description:
Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, discussed regional developments in a phone call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio. They reviewed the situation in Sudan and its humanitarian consequences, and Sheikh Abdullah affirmed the UAE's support for efforts towards an immediate and unconditional ceasefire and a comprehensive, civilian-led political process.

item.title: flydubai announced five additional destinations from December: the first nonstop flights by a UAE carrier to Aktau and Atyrau in Kazakhstan…
item.description:
flydubai announced five additional destinations from December: the first nonstop flights by a UAE carrier to Aktau and Atyrau in Kazakhstan and Tyumen in Russia, and resumed services to Shymkent and Samarkand. Atyrau flights begin on 18 December, Aktau and Tyumen on 19 December, Shymkent on 25 December and Samarkand on 29 December, at two to three flights a week, with return fares from AED 2,500.

item.title: The sixth edition of the Aswan Forum for Sustainable Peace and Development opened in Aswan today, Saturday, running over Saturday and Sunda…
item.description:
The sixth edition of the Aswan Forum for Sustainable Peace and Development opened in Aswan today, Saturday, running over Saturday and Sunday under the theme "Redefining the Global Commons: Africa's Active Role in an Era of Turbulence". In his speech, President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi set out three messages: that multilateral cooperation is a vital choice to be reformed rather than abandoned, that Africa must be a genuine partner in shaping the rules of the international order, and that its vision must put development first alongside reform of the international financial system to ease access to concessional finance and debt burdens. The forum also hosts a "Middle East Dialogue" on containing escalation.

item.title: Gold extended its decline in Egypt on Saturday morning, with 21-carat at about EGP 5,460 selling and EGP 5,410 buying, 24-carat at about EG…
item.description:
Gold extended its decline in Egypt on Saturday morning, with 21-carat at about EGP 5,460 selling and EGP 5,410 buying, 24-carat at about EGP 6,240, 18-carat at about EGP 4,680 and the gold pound at EGP 43,680. The gold pound has lost EGP 3,960 since the start of the week (about 8.3%), while the local premium has risen to nearly EGP 150 per gram of 21-carat, and the global ounce held between USD 3,532 and USD 3,538 with exchanges closed for the weekend.

item.description:
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority expects a slight rise in temperatures to continue today, Saturday, with highs of 28°C in Greater Cairo and 31°C to 33°C in southern Upper Egypt. item.title: US President Donald Trump told a White House press conference, a day after meeting Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladi…
item.description:
US President Donald Trump told a White House press conference, a day after meeting Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin and the three countries agreeing to hold nuclear non-proliferation talks, that China is expanding its nuclear arsenal at an accelerated pace and will catch up with the United States within ten years. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said dialogue among the three nuclear powers is essential, while the Pentagon estimates China's warhead stockpile at slightly above 600 as of 2024, on a path to more than 1,000 by 2030.

item.title: Four people were killed and 35 injured in a fire at the Hartha power station north of Basra that spread to nearby homes, according to the I…
item.description:
Four people were killed and 35 injured in a fire at the Hartha power station north of Basra that spread to nearby homes, according to the Iraqi News Agency. Basra health authorities said an explosion in one of the gas pipelines feeding the plant caused the blaze, damaging more than 17 homes, before civil defence brought it under control, and operations at the station were halted.

item.description:
A magnitude 6.7 to 6.8 earthquake struck the Junin region of central Peru on Friday evening at a depth of 129 kilometres, felt by residents of the capital Lima who rushed into the streets, with television footage showing lawmakers leaving parliament. Authorities reported no immediate casualties or major damage; Peru records at least 400 earthquakes a year due to its location on the Ring of Fire.

item.description:
Anthropic shares fell 8.5% on Friday to USD 88.19 in their second session, after opening on Thursday at USD 83 and closing at USD 97, a 17% gain that valued the company at about USD 1.76 trillion. The record listing failed to restore confidence in AI stocks: Seoul, Tokyo and Taipei led Asian losses, the S&P 500 and Dow Jones entered technical correction territory, and the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to erase its 2026 gains, while Nvidia lost more than 14% after reports of an investigation into its accounting practices.
